name: cdn-edge-allowlist
description: Of Cloudflare's four published prefixes only one is reachable: the other three are dropped at the border. The relay is reachable too. Op cdn: the route carries, through an edge address in the one open prefix — the picker must find it among the signed seeds without downloading a range list.
analogue: Per-ISP Cloudflare prefix health: during the 2025-2026 shutdowns some Cloudflare ranges stayed open on some ISPs while others were cut (research/intel-and-some-working-methods.md, 'Protocol status'; plan §2.7, 'which Cloudflare prefixes pass per ISP today'). Model: a static allowlist of one /26, silent drop of the rest. Not modelled: which prefixes, per ISP, today — no rig can say.
